name: Meschede (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Meschede (a saint beside a black cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Meschede; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Meschede arms — saint and black cross on white
